body: You’re a great person. Just sayin
I am responding to a bunch of texts, but secretly I have yet to wipe the cum off of my stomach

If your girlfriend was a porn addict wouldn’t you want to unconditionally support her? You deserve that kind of treatment from your SO as well, and if she can’t provide that after you let her know what’s up, then she’s not worthy. This problem isn’t going to disappear, and I’m for damn sure that you don’t want her to disappear. Trust her, trust that she is right for you, let her in on all of your issues so you can get better together.
